title: Robo Radio 11: Andrea Piccinno
guestTitle: Founder & CEO of Zeta Industries, creator of Vertex
description: Robo Radio 11 is live. This month Hello Robo hosted Andrea Piccinno, a mechanical engineer from Italy building 3D-printed exoskeletons. We talked about the story behind exoskeletons, why functional alone isn't enough, and why robotics should be about augmenting humans — not replacing them.
